name: Mistrène
source:
One of the generals of the planetary invasion force, the Dai-Lust.
She is loyal and cares for her subordinates.
She came to Earth to make it the 22nd colony planet.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.alicesoft.com/escalayer/echara.html]official site[/url]]
